message:
So, the other night we had a surprise power outage, and I was feeling pretty smug about being the one who was prepared for once! I grabbed my trusty flashlight and a couple of lanterns I had tucked away for emergencies. I even had my phone charged up with a power bank ready to go. 

Instead of the usual scramble, we ended up playing board games by lantern light, making the best of it. It felt nice to be the calm one in the room, knowing I had a little backup in place. 

Have you ever found yourself unexpectedly ready for a moment like this? What are your go-to tips for staying cozy during a blackout? 🕯️
